stop_reason: Attempt 3 still has no usable watch photo for ref. 6239. Wikimedia Commons searches (six queries, including the exact ref and 'Paul Newman Daytona') returned no free-licence file for the 6239. The library photo rolex-6239.jpg is credited 'Image: Rolex', which is not on state/permissions.json (the only entry there is Rockstar Games, for GTA VI). Phillips lot photos are auction lot photos and are not allowed. Facts are sourced (Rolex 1963 introduction, Newman's 1968 6239 per Phillips, roughly 14,000 6239s per Sotheby's). Input correction: the Newman Daytona sale was in New York (Phillips, 26 Oct 2017), not Geneva; the $17.75m total includes buyer's premium, hammer not confirmed. To unblock: owner supplies a licensed 6239 photo with a credit added to permissions.json, or a Commons file naming the 6239 (licence and credit recorded), then the run can be retried.
